'''Viktor Zheleznyakov''' was a Vorkutan industrial planner and radical theorist associated with the origin of [[Gorodovaya Syndikalizm]].

== Theory ==

In 1923, Zheleznyakov wrote ''The City Belongs to All''. The work argued that modern industrial cities could not be governed by workplace unions alone, because factory life, housing, transport, public services, and municipal planning formed one integrated system.

His theory helped frame the worker-assembly politics that later expanded during the [[Vorkutan Labor Crisis]].
